mapper.insert: INSERT INTO patterns ( user_id, pattern_name, author, pdf_path, thumbnail_path, total_pages, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{patternName}, #{author}, #{pdfPath}, #{thumbnailPath}, #{totalPages}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT pattern_id, user_id, pattern_name, author, pdf_path, thumbnail_path, total_pages, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM patterns WHERE pattern_id = #{patternId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT pattern_id, user_id, pattern_name, author, pdf_path, thumbnail_path, total_pages, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM patterns WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE patterns SET pattern_name = #{patternName}, author = #{author}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE pattern_id = #{patternId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
